import sys
import bisect

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    n = data[0]
    nums = data[1:1+n]
    w = data[1+n]
    
    nums.sort()
    
    ans = 0
    for i in range(1, 1001):
        left = bisect.bisect_left(nums, i)
        right = bisect.bisect_right(nums, i + w)
        cur = right - left
        if cur > ans:
            ans = cur
    
    sys.stdout.write(str(ans))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
